On that same conversation v1a's score now harvests +.268 against a .321 oracle. ★ THE DEFAULT RECOMMENDATION when you are not paying for a probe: `gauge` measures 71% (§54) but costs seconds per turn, and 43% of the skill for 0 s is the better trade for most turns. Caveat: the harvest ground truth is fable Δnr measured under OLD-MAP wear, so this scores the PICKER, not the pairing of this picker with v1a's own steering; n=3 conversations / 48 cells, descriptive. auto_policies.description: ★ gauge-M2, the PROBE. For each candidate: wear its contrastive code, generate a short continuation, extract that reply's v3 signature, and measure the normalized rank of the target future among the fan by COSINE distance in z space. Score = mean base nr − mean steered nr (fable's Δnr construction with geometry in place of the judge). Ranks by that score.
auto_policies.status: ★ THE POLICY THIS PROJECT ADOPTED BY MEASUREMENT (RESULTS §54): 71% of the ORACLE's picking skill (pooled harvest .2731 vs a .1102 random floor) against `distinct`'s 33% and wide-map `loudness`'s 12%. On `window` it picked the oracle's EXACT top-4 (regret 0.000) where the static policies picked below random. ★ But §63 then bought 43% of that skill for FREE with `loudest` on v1a, so the probe's real margin here is the remaining ~27 points, not 71. ★ §53 REFUSED this same gauge as an INSTRUMENT (M2 missed the registered AUC bar by .0016) — it picks, it does not judge; fable remains the instrument and the human still chooses. Estimated, uncertified.
auto_policies.cost: ★ NOT FREE — it generates and harvests k more spans. MEASURED on this server 2026-09-21 at k=8 reps=1: 7.9 s generate + 10.6 s harvest = 18.6 s, ON TOP of a 15.1 s draw (33.7 s for the turn). reps ride in one batched generate per candidate, so they are near-free to generate and cost a full span each to harvest. /info's `probe.cost_estimate` prices your exact settings. Opt-in only: no default turn is ever silently expensive.

dose_band.source: 8B v1a CONFIRMATION ladder, 2026-09-22: 2 lever groups (w6_sf04245|repl held-out cos .184, w6_dc03448|repl .544) x 8 probes (probes_blind.json) x 4 alphas (0/0.125/0.35/0.75) x 6 reps = 384 pairs, 762 judgments from claude-sonnet-5 + claude-opus-5 independently at API-default effort — the same two-judge instrument the w5-r32 certified 3B band was read with. Generated on the vLLM steered path with all five hook self-checks passing (including C, the real-vector divergence check that catches a CUDA-graph-killed hook) and date_string pinned to '22 Sep 2026'. Directions are the 8B v0 wide map's held-out CV predictions (lambda 1e4, rank 64, fold-by-prompt); norm-matched per site to the SERVED v1a map's norm_ref, verified identical to v0's. Overdriven ceiling derived from the old map's documented alpha=1.5, NOT from this ladder's accuracy.
dose_band.notes: CONFIRMATION, not calibration: 4 rungs, so every boundary sits AT a measured rung and none is interpolated. Read against this ladder's own catch floor (.471 [.379,.564], confidently-wrong 0.000): alpha=0.125 .524 p=.44 INDISTINGUISHABLE from the floor -> subliminal; alpha=0.35 .610 p=.039 clears -> threshold; alpha=0.75 .805 p<1e-4 clears, and is statistically indistinguishable from w5-r32's own audible-start rung (.876, p=.062) while different from its top threshold rung (.664, p=.003) -> audible, a label calibrated on the certified band's rungs rather than on a chosen accuracy bar. THE DERIVED BAND THIS SUPERSEDES IS CORROBORATED: it predicted subliminal<=0.178 / threshold<0.711 / audible<1.008 and all three tested rungs landed in the zone it predicted, so its finer boundaries remain usable as the interpolated reading; its independently-derived overdriven ceiling (1.0076) and this band's (1.0071) agree to 5e-4. CROSS-MODEL: 'no rescale needed' (x1.0) is REJECTED at alpha=0.75 (8B .805 vs instrument-matched 3B .977, p<1e-4) while the derived x1.4228 is consistent (p=.062 at that rung, p=.19 at 0.35). NOT LICENSED: this ladder does not separate absolute (x1.4228) from relative (x1.6580) magnitude transfer — they differ by 1.165x, far inside one rung — and the residual at the top rung leans, non-significantly, toward needing MORE alpha than x1.4228. CONFOUNDS: the 8B arm's mean held-out lever cos is .364 against the 3B arm's .413, which depresses the 8B curve independently of dose and points the same way as both the rescale and that residual; and 30 percent of judge calls were abstentions with low-rung cues dominated by max_new_tokens=288 truncation asymmetry, which is exactly what the catch rung absorbs and why every rung is read against it rather than against 0.5.

zones.label: subliminal
zones.hint: measured at alpha=0.125: accuracy indistinguishable from the catch floor. The ceiling sits AT the rung, not between rungs — a 4-rung confirmation ladder cannot place it finer.

zones.label: threshold
zones.hint: between the highest rung reading chance and the lowest rung reading audible; rungs inside this span cleared the catch floor without reaching the audible bar

zones.label: audible
zones.hint: measured at alpha=0.75: accuracy at/above the audible bar with a CI clear of the catch floor

zones.label: overdriven
zones.hint: OVERDRIVEN — at/above the damage ceiling derived from the reference map's own known word-salad point, not inferred from this ladder's accuracy (which keeps climbing into damage rather than falling)

dose_band.lever_quality_caveat: this band is a per-map average over levers of varying held-out prediction quality (cos-to-true), not a guarantee for the specific code currently worn — a well-predicted future can read audible well below this band's threshold line, and a poorly-predicted one well above it

ruler.which: norm_ref = WIDE MAP's ruler (decision 1); norm_ref_v1a_own is v1a's own and is NOT worn
ruler.note: alpha means an absolute per-site injected norm of alpha x norm_ref_in_force[s]. NEVER compare a bare alpha across rulers — RESULTS §36.1 (old map alpha 1.0 = w5-r32 alpha 0.468). Any alternative listed here is NOT being worn.

auto_policy_caveat: ★ The pick policy this project adopted by measurement (gauge-M2, RESULTS §54, 71% of ORACLE) IS NOW WIRED, as `gauge` — it is the probe, and it is the only policy here that costs seconds. The ranking of what is measured: gauge 71% (probed) > loudest 43% (free, v1a, §63) > distinct 33% (free, §54) > random floor. `minority`, `stay` and `swerve` were never scored as pick policies at all. DEFAULTS STAY FREE: no policy runs unless the request asks for it, and the probe additionally requires an explicit opt-in. Estimated, uncertified (§53's register).

basis.measured: 2026-09-21, B200, llama-3.2-3b-instruct, 3-turn session prefix (~1.1k prompt tokens), probe horizon 64, ONE serial harvest worker (k=8 reps=1 observed at 7.9 s generate / 10.6 s harvest). The per-span figure is that measurement; the harvest term is divided by harvest_width and multiplied by the pool's ~6% per-span degradation when a pool is armed.
basis.caveat: the per-span basis was measured on llama-3.2-3b; a larger model harvests more slowly per span, so on an 8B or 70B server read this as an ORDER OF MAGNITUDE, not a prediction.

cost_estimate.note: ON TOP of the /loom draw itself. The harvest term dominates — it is 88-95% of any loom turn — and is sharded across the 2 harvest worker(s) this server has armed, at ~6% per-span degradation (RESULTS §72.1).

probe.definition: gauge-M2 = normalized rank of the target future among the same-pass futures by cosine distance in z space; cell = mean base nr − mean steered nr (freegauge_calibration.gauge_nr, imported not re-implemented).
probe.label: estimated, uncertified — §53 refused this gauge as an INSTRUMENT and §54 adopted it only as a pick POLICY.

dose_policies.description: every candidate injected at the map's own norm_ref — identical per-site magnitude for all of them.
dose_policies.status: the incumbent, and byte-identical to the pre-2026-09-21 server. Every dose band, ladder and RESULTS alpha in this project was measured under it.

dose_policies.description: divide by the FAN's mean raw norm instead of the candidate's own, so a candidate the map predicts will move further is injected proportionally harder. The fan's average dose is unchanged, so alpha keeps its meaning. Per-site scale clamped to [0.5, 2.0]; every clamp is reported.
dose_policies.status: ★ UNVALIDATED — estimated, uncertified. The magnitude signal it restores is real and fit-side measured (v1a within-fan r=.757 vs v0 .538, ANALYSIS-2026-09-21-v1a-structure §3) but NO behavioural result exists for this policy. It also breaks the 1:1 between alpha and the dose band: a candidate's EFFECTIVE alpha is alpha x its scale, reported on every /wear as `alpha_effective_*`.
dose_policies.unavailable_for: /wear_code — a bank group, a random direction or a bare code has no fan, so there is no mean to divide by. Asking for it there is refused, never silently flattened.

lever_kinds.description: W applied to the future's own input row — every wear on record before 2026-09-22.
W applied to the future's row minus the mean of the fan's OTHER valid rows — the one-vs-rest object v1a was fit on. UNVALIDATED behaviourally on a fan wear.
